```lean
intro n hn
have h1 : n ^ 2 - 2 * n ≥ 3 := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]
  apply Nat.le_add_right
  exact (Nat.succ_le_iff 2).mpr (Nat.succ_le_of_le hn)
have h2 : n ^ 2 - 2 * n - 3 ≥ 0 :=
  by rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm]; exact h1
exact (Nat.add_le_add_right h2 3).trans (Nat.le_refl 3)
```
